dedupe_keys.name: fichier de formes des voies du reseau ferre national

description: Fichier de formes des voies du Réseau Ferré National is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Que représente ce jeu de données ? Ce jeu recense les voies ferroviaires du Réseau Ferré National (RFN): Voies principales (VPL, VPA) rattachées à une ligne ferroviaire exploitée. Voies de service (VS) hors gares (exclut les voies de service situées en gare). Information sur le format Format: Shapefile (fichiers.shp,.dbf,.shx,.prj ). Coverage: France. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Réseau. Its keywords are SNCF RESEAU, Infrastructure, Géolocalisation. The portal shows 2020-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/cgu/A1#A1). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
